external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal and pushes a nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: The service loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where supplier compliance documents remain stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A landing bucket in the organisation's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: upload compliance paperwork
data_flows.description: A supplier uploads insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A supplier signs in to the portal using credentials issued by the vendor.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: review and approve
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it

data_flows.name: store paperwork
data_flows.description: The portal stores the uploaded documents in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: Conflicting positive claims about transport protection: System description says, "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The same source says, "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is."

data_flows.name: pick up extract
data_flows.description: The supplier master service picks up the nightly extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.
data_flows.data_description: Nightly supplier data extract as a plain CSV

data_flows.name: write supplier records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes the extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor platform
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-hosted SaaS environment containing the supplier document portal and stored documents.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The system is explicitly described as a portal through which suppliers sign in and upload paperwork.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform holds confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores compliance paperwork and staff contact details, whose disclosure can harm people or the business.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket holds confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It receives a supplier data extract containing supplier records and staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database holds confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores supplier records derived from the extract, including staff contact details.
